title: Prosecution (GFF)
synopsis:
Young German-Korean prosecutor Seyo Kim is determined to bring far-right extremists to justice in Germany. When she survives a racist attack on her own life, she defies her superiors and takes the perpetrators to court herself, uncovering a right-wing network with ties deep into the institutions meant to stop it. Director Faraz Shariat's second feature is grounded in years of meticulous research into Germany's legal system and its handling of far-right violence, a subject that feels urgent at the moment.

 

2026    Panorama Audience Award, C.I.C.A.E. Award, Heiner Carow Prize, Berlinale

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
在右翼勢力抬頭的今時今日，種族歧視以至相關暴力襲擊更是周之無日。年輕韓裔檢察官調查種族仇恨罪行，竟在光天化日之下受襲。誓要找出真兇的她並未因此受驚噤聲，只是在調查過程中卻受到上司重重阻撓，令她更是孤立無援。真相愈辯愈明，令人震驚的卻是暴力罪行竟受體制內極右勢力包庇，暗無天日。法Faraz Shariat 第二部長片改編真人真事，直擊當今德國種族主義勢力圖謀。

 

2026     柏林影展電影大觀觀眾票選獎、國際藝術電影院聯盟獎、海納卡羅獎
